g.text: pivac EXT board rev B: DS2482-100 1-wire master, three probe sockets, 24 VAC sense supply and the Pi's 5.1 V supply, link to the INT board

g.desc: pivac EXT board rev B: DS2482-100 1-wire master, three probe sockets, 24 VAC sense supply and the Pi's 5.1 V supply, link to the INT board

g.text: U3 makes 5.1 V isolated for the Pi: C4 at its output, J4 to a USB-C pigtail. Remote (pin 3) open = on. COM never meets GND.

g.desc: U3 makes 5.1 V isolated for the Pi: C4 at its output, J4 to a USB-C pigtail. Remote (pin 3) open = on. COM never meets GND.

g.text: 24 VAC in on J3, PTC F1, bridge D1-D4, C3 470 uF: VS about 35 V DC against COM, out to INT on J1.6/J1.7 and into U3.

g.desc: 24 VAC in on J3, PTC F1, bridge D1-D4, C3 470 uF: VS about 35 V DC against COM, out to INT on J1.6/J1.7 and into U3.

g.text: Rollback to w1-gpio: fit R1 and bridge JP1, and GPIO4 becomes the bus data line.

g.desc: Rollback to w1-gpio: fit R1 and bridge JP1, and GPIO4 becomes the bus data line.

g.text: Probe sockets PTSM 0,5/3-HH-2,5-THR: 1 VCC, 2 DATA, 3 GND. JP2 sends H3's DATA to the bus (1-2) or to U2 (2-3).

g.desc: Probe sockets PTSM 0,5/3-HH-2,5-THR: 1 VCC, 2 DATA, 3 GND. JP2 sends H3's DATA to the bus (1-2) or to U2 (2-3).
